content.text:
I found no unsupported claims in the overview. Each of its eight claims matches the record, so I flagged nothing.

- **Who did it:** The record says the Mitigation Agent reverted the flag and the Code-Fix Agent opened the fix. The writer was told to use the "what was done" list, which names Argus for both, so calling them Argus is fine.
- **"Still a draft":** The record holds nothing about PR #570 after it was opened as a draft, so saying it is still a draft and has not been put in place doesn't go beyond the record.
- **"Likely":** The word stays on the group of shoppers the cause names as likely affected, and nowhere else.
